author: Uderia
description: The reference implementation of an assurance-module pack, shipped disabled. It demonstrates the two declarative forms — a pattern rule over the answer, and a metric expression over counts — and a tunable that becomes a slider. Copy it, do not enable it: it asserts a disclaimer rule no real deployment shares.

properties.label: Regulatory disclaimer
properties.question: Does an answer that gives financial figures carry the required disclaimer?

properties.label: Answer brevity
properties.question: Is the answer within the length this deployment considers readable?

lane_notes.in_flight: length is a style preference — withholding an answer for being long would be the wrong product.

disclaimer_present.desc: Whether an answer stating money carries the disclaimer the deployment requires.
disclaimer_present.long: A deterministic phrase rule: an answer containing a currency figure must also contain one of the clearing phrases. It reports; it does not decide. Bound in flight it can reach the gate that consults this property; bound post-hoc it grades the same assessment, so the two can never disagree.
